What she hears at bedtime. 🌙

Lily is six, hiding with a flashlight under the blanket. Scared of the dark. And every night, you always came. You knelt by her bed and prayed. ✨

At nine, she wrote a list of her worries. Mom tucked it back in and prayed over every single thing on that list. 📝

At thirteen she rolled her eyes. At eighteen, Mom still came in to check, whispered her prayer into the dark… and Lily said, "I know." 🥹

6,570 bedtime prayers. She heard every single one. ❤️

You didn't make her fearless. You pointed her to Jesus. 🙏 "He who keeps you will not slumber." Psalm 121:3 (ESV)

Years later, she kneels by her own child's bed and says the same words: "The Lord bless you and keep you…" ❤️

73% of kids aged 4-12 have fears at night (Muris et al., 2001). Some hide them under the blanket. Keep coming in. Keep praying.

BravePath Kids is a Christ-centered 21-day journey for childhood anxiety, made for parents and kids to do together:
✨ Simple anxiety skills
📖 Scripture they can hold onto
🙏 Prayer
❤️ Love in action
Ages 4-6, 7-9 and 10-12.
